Alger, 9 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 9, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The Minister of Higher Education and Scientific Research, Kamel Baddari, discussed with a Chinese delegation on the evening of November 9 the project to build a data center dedicated to artificial intelligence at the National Higher School of Artificial Intelligence (ENSIA), located in the Chahid Abdelhafid Haddadene scientific and technological hub in Sidi Abdellah.
Une réunion technique sur le site de l'E: A technical meeting on the ENSIA site
Les échanges, tenus à l'ENSIA, ont porté: The discussions, held at ENSIA, focused on the technical and engineering aspects of the project. The ministry specifically highlighted infrastructure and technological equipment, the implementation schedule, as well as environmental and regulatory requirements. The objective is to bring together the necessary conditions to complete this strategic facility according to international standards.
Pour le ministère, ce projet constitue u: For the ministry, this project represents a qualitative step forward in strengthening national capabilities in high-performance computing and developing the country's digital and research infrastructure. It is also expected to consolidate Algeria's position as a regional hub for artificial intelligence through international partnerships based on knowledge and technology transfer and the strengthening of national skills.
L'annonce a été publiée sur la page Face: The announcement was published on the ministry's official Facebook page under the heading "Algerian-Chinese strategic partnership in advanced technologies and artificial intelligence".
